documents.title: Pope County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 190 pages. Amounts are the "2026 Appropriated" (pp. 43-44) for funds and departments; categories from the "Amount Requested Next Year 2026" column of each Application for Appropriation, used only because each request adds to the appropriated amount to the cent column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
